operatingNotes: Publish Eventbrite pages 3-4 weeks before each paid event.
Use Wednesday trivia to promote the next paid event with a QR slide and host mention.
Use Thursday bingo for theme testing: the bingo theme should preview the next week of marketing whenever possible.
Push paid events with a 10-day countdown, 72-hour reminder, and day-before story/reel.
